text_block_list.text:
Vodka finished her first Classic race, 
emerging victorious over Daiwa Scarlet.

Having given everything they had, the two 
exchanged promises for a rematch while 
bickering. However... Vodka's next 
scheduled race is her true target: the 
Japanese Derby.

To face her rival, she would have to give 
up on the Nippon Derby and head down the 
Tiara route toward the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks).

Which one should she choose...? Vodka 
found herself torn and wavering.
